name: last30days-cn
description: Last-30-days research across Chinese platforms (Weibo, Xiaohongshu, Bilibili, Zhihu, Douyin, WeChat, Baidu, Toutiao) with engagement-weighted ranking, cross-platform clustering and Swiss/IKB HTML reports; a cross-platform hot-search board (--hot); optional Hacker News / GitHub / Reddit and an upstream last30days bridge.

settings.name: Weibo Cookie
settings.description: Optional logged-in m.weibo.cn cookie; Weibo search requires login since 2025.

settings.name: Zhihu Cookie
settings.description: Optional Zhihu login cookie (z_c0) for search.

settings.name: Bilibili Cookie
settings.description: Optional Bilibili cookie (SESSDATA) to reduce risk-control blocks.

settings.name: TikHub API Key
settings.description: Optional TikHub key for Douyin search.

settings.name: WeChat API Key
settings.description: Optional WeChat public-account search API key (jisuapi).

settings.name: Baidu API Key
settings.description: Optional Baidu Qianfan AI Search (web_search) Bearer key.

settings.name: Xiaohongshu MCP Base URL
settings.description: Optional self-hosted xiaohongshu-mcp base URL, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:18060.

settings.name: GitHub Token
settings.description: Optional token to raise GitHub search limits for the overseas GitHub source.
